scientific_classification.reason: T15 market captures are prospective, but the successor forward scorer is reconstructed after the race dates. Model, market mapping, calibration form, and gates were frozen before Stage2 outcome evaluation.

warmup.same_day_parameters: identical for every eligible race on the same race_date

mapping_specific_calibration.gamma: fit separately for each mapping on the same strictly-prior eligible settled cohort
mapping_specific_calibration.beta: fit separately for each mapping after that mapping's current-date gamma is fit
mapping_specific_calibration.beta_training_market_distribution: recompute each prior race q_market using the current-date gamma for that mapping

local_state_may_store: calibration parameter values needed for next-date predictions
local_state_must_not_persist: formal pooled performance summaries before unblind

cohort_semantics.prediction_cohort: market cohort with successfully frozen exact successor prediction artifact before that date's outcome reconciliation
cohort_semantics.evaluation_row: prediction cohort with later official target having exactly three distinct Top3 starters
cohort_semantics.pre_outcome_model_input_failure: MODEL_INPUT_BLOCKED; excluded deterministically before outcome access and always counted by reason
cohort_semantics.outcome_target_failure: OUTCOME_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE; excluded after reconciliation and always counted by reason

outcome_target.authority: Job004 starter semantics and Amendment001 effective-rank/Top3 integrity
outcome_target.top3_requirement: exactly three distinct actual starters with official Top3 positions
outcome_target.winning_pair_labels: three unordered pairs among those three horses
outcome_target.late_t15_withdrawal: T15 pair distribution remains on the frozen T15 roster; no post-scratch renormalization

eb_continuation.post_cutoff_update_universe: ALL South-Kanto target races after cutoff, not only T15 market-eligible races
eb_continuation.post_settlement_state_update: use Job004 actual-starter residual semantics after the date settles
eb_continuation.raw_prediction_reconstruction: fixed M2, strict history source_race_date < target_race_date, pre-race-safe target columns only, final actual-starter support allowed only because state update occurs after settlement and affects future dates only
eb_continuation.date_d_state_used_for_scoring: only residual observations with source race_date < d

historical_parity_before_real_replay.feature_adapter_sample: 40 deterministic Fold4 races: 10 evenly-spaced sorted race keys per venue from 2026-01-01..2026-07-31
historical_parity_before_real_replay.scorer_parity_scope: all Fold4 validation races 2026-01-01..2026-07-31 using frozen Job003B materialized inputs

artifact_policy.prediction_artifacts: immutable local outputs, content-hashed, no outcomes
artifact_policy.date_freeze_marker: required before any same-date outcome reconciliation
artifact_policy.reconciliation_artifacts: local untracked, official Top3 labels and EB residual state only; no formal aggregate performance
artifact_policy.git_evidence: aggregate counts and hashes only while blinded
